goal: Implement first-run landing and sign-in UX improvements for Roadtrippin per spec at documentation/research/roadtrippin-first-run-auth-ux.md
plan_summary: Implement first-run landing and sign-in UX overhaul for Roadtrippin as specified in roadtrippin-first-run-auth-ux.md. Work covers: (1) branded landing screen, (2) split sign-in into progressive-disclosure Step 1 (email) and Step 2 (OTP), (3) display-name onboarding screen for new users only, (4) empty-state for trip list, (5) authService abstraction for future SMS OTP, (6) invite-code state preservation across auth redirect. COORDINATION DEP: Supabase Confirm signup + Magic Link email templates must be updated to {{ .Token }} by human with dashboard access before new-user OTP flow works end-to-end.

subtasks.description: Refactor authService: rename requestEmailOtp/verifyEmailOtp to requestOtp/verifyOtp with identifier-type detection (email vs E.164 phone). Phone path returns safe not-enabled error. Update Zod schemas. Update call sites in sign-in.tsx.
acceptance_criteria: requestOtp and verifyOtp are the only exported auth functions
Valid email routes to signInWithOtp({ email })
E.164 phone returns fail(sms_not_enabled)
Invalid identifier returns fail(invalid_auth_request)
sign-in.tsx compiles with zero TS errors after call-site update
Pre-existing sign-in tests pass with updated names

subtasks.description: Replace app/src/app/index.tsx with branded landing screen. Authenticated users skip to /(tabs)/trips. Unauthenticated: wordmark, tagline, 3 value-prop bullets, Get started CTA, Sign in link. Both CTAs navigate to /(auth)/sign-in.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated session on mount calls router.replace(/(tabs)/trips)
Three bullets render in exact amended copy
Tagline is exactly: Road Trippin with your crew.
Get started and Sign in both navigate to /(auth)/sign-in
Open trip list and Phase 0 scaffold strings absent from output
AppScreen is root; no new component files created

subtasks.description: Create authFlowStore.ts (Zustand, in-memory, no AsyncStorage). Rework sign-in.tsx to Step 1: email-only input, Send code CTA, inline errors with safe messages, navigate to /(auth)/sign-in-verify on success. Remove OTP/display-name/Phase 1 elements.
acceptance_criteria: authFlowStore exports email, setEmail, clearEmail; no AsyncStorage calls
Rendered sign-in.tsx has only: heading, sub-copy, footnote, email TextInput, Send code button
No OTP input, no display name, no Phase 1 text in rendered output
Send code disabled while email empty or invalid
On success: setEmail called and router.push(/(auth)/sign-in-verify)
Rate limit error shows user-safe copy
Zod schema tests: valid email passes; empty/invalid/padded strings handled

subtasks.description: Create (auth)/sign-in-verify.tsx (Step 2). Reads email from authFlowStore. OTP input, Verify code button, 30s resend cooldown. On success: profile check -> display-name (new user) or trips (returning). Back nav to Step 1.
acceptance_criteria: Displays email from authFlowStore in sub-copy
Verify code disabled unless exactly 6 chars entered
New user (null profile) routes to /(onboarding)/display-name
Returning user (existing profile) routes to /(tabs)/trips
Invalid token error shows safe copy
Resend link hidden for 30s then visible; tapping resets timer
Back nav goes to /(auth)/sign-in
Zod tests: 6 digits passes; 5/7 digits fail; 6 non-numeric fails

subtasks.description: Create (onboarding)/display-name.tsx. New users only. Progress 1/2. Display name input. On Continue: ensureUserProfile; on success -> permissions; after 2 failures soft-skip to permissions anyway.
acceptance_criteria: File at app/src/app/(onboarding)/display-name.tsx
Progress indicator shows 1 of 2
Exact heading and sub-copy per spec
Continue disabled when trimmed input is empty
Success navigates to /(onboarding)/permissions
After 2 failures logs error and still navigates to /(onboarding)/permissions
Zod tests: non-empty string passes; empty string fails; whitespace-only fails after trim

subtasks.description: Add empty-state branch to (tabs)/trips.tsx. When trips.length===0 and load complete: No trips yet heading, sub-copy, Start a trip primary button (-> /trips/create), Join with a code secondary button. Non-empty: existing trip card list unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Empty state shows No trips yet. and correct sub-copy when trips===0 and no error
Start a trip primary button navigates to /trips/create
Join with a code secondary button navigates to join/code-entry
Non-empty state: No trips yet. not rendered; trip cards rendered
Hero card and Refresh button present in both states
No new component files created

subtasks.description: Invite-code state preservation (Path C). In invites/[code].tsx: persist code to sessionStorage/inviteFlowStore before auth redirect. In sign-in-verify.tsx: after OTP success check for pending code; if found consume and route to invite; if not found use normal ST-04 routing.
acceptance_criteria: invites/[code].tsx persists code to sessionStorage/inviteFlowStore before nav to sign-in
After OTP verify with pending code: router.replace to invite with restored code, code removed from storage
After OTP verify without pending code: normal ST-04 routing unchanged
Invite code not in any Expo Router href or params during auth flow
Comment block in sign-in-verify.tsx documents Path C logic
Zero TS errors in invites/[code].tsx and sign-in-verify.tsx

subtasks.description: End-to-end QA pass for ST-01 through ST-07. Verify all routing paths A/B/C/D, run all tests, confirm Zod schema tests pass, produce written QA checklist.
acceptance_criteria: All pre-existing (auth) tests pass
New Zod schema tests from ST-03/04/05 all pass
Path A/B/C/D manually traced and recorded in QA checklist with no unexpected navigations
Developer strings (Phase 1, Phase 0 scaffold, Open trip list) absent from all user-facing screens
tsc --noEmit reports zero errors across all modified/new files
